items.name: MATVerse Ecommerce
items.problem: General ecommerce shoppers need a clear way to search products, browse departments, compare items, and move quickly toward cart and profile actions.
items.solution: MATVerse provides a responsive marketplace experience with department browsing, product search, featured deals, product cards, cart entry points, and profile flows.
items.summary: A deployed ecommerce marketplace for electronics, fashion, grocery, home, beauty, sports, baby products, and eco-friendly picks.

items.name: Bookeeds
items.problem: Students often struggle to organize goals, study routines, and daily focus in one purposeful workflow.
items.solution: Bookeeds helps students plan tasks, track goals, and reduce distraction through a more intentional digital productivity experience.
items.summary: A student productivity product focused on planning, goal tracking, and distraction reduction.

items.name: Blood For Life
items.problem: Finding blood donors quickly can be difficult during urgent situations.
items.solution: The platform helps users search donors by blood group and location, request support, and manage emergency response more efficiently.
items.summary: A blood donation platform for donor search, requests, and emergency coordination.

items.name: AI Controller for PC
items.problem: Common desktop actions can be repetitive and slower when users need hands-free control.
items.solution: A voice-command desktop automation experiment for launching apps, running searches, and handling common computer actions.
items.summary: A hands-free desktop automation prototype using voice commands and AI-assisted workflows.
